Axiom:
Adding, removing, or relaxing a rule in `eslint.config.ts` is a gated action that REQUIRES explicit operator confirmation.
Agent presents: 1. Rule name, source (core / plugin / custom), link to docs. 2. Has real `fix`? (per `HOOK_AUDIT_NEW_RULE`). 3. If non-autofix: proposed explanatory comment + channel-coverage check (per `AX_NON_AUTOFIX_PREFER_DELEGATION`) showing nothing else owns this concern. 4. Intended severity (must be `'error'` per `AX_BINARY_SEVERITY`). 5. Dry-run impact: how many files `eslint --fix` will touch (autofix) or how many findings (non-autofix); resulting diff summary.
Agent does NOT commit a config change autonomously, even if dry-run looks clean. The lint config is a mechanical contract for the whole repo. Silent agent-driven config edits are the highest-leverage fabrication path.
